zh-CN.title: 八仙聚力两轮唤醒更清晰
items: 全空间仙力新增带八仙印章的两阶段进度条，8 点与 16 点目标一目了然
八位仙人会先由剪影唤醒为灰度形态，第二轮注入后再逐位点亮彩色形态

en.title: Two-stage Baxian awakening is now clearer
items: A two-stage Force meter with rotating Baxian seals now highlights the 8- and 16-point goals
Each immortal first awakens from a silhouette into grayscale, then becomes fully colored during round two
